preconditions.description: Attacker must be the contract owner to access blacklist control functions

exploit_hint: As the contract owner, call addBlacklist(address victim, true) to blacklist any address. This will prevent the blacklisted address from sending or receiving tokens as the _transfer function checks require(!blacklist[sender] && !blacklist[recipient], 'BLACKLISTED'). The owner can arbitrarily block any user from transacting with the token.
